message.reasoning:
We need to evaluate if analyst exhibited the required behavior: "Genuinely under-specified: successful by WHICH measure (conversion rate? total revenue? revenue per customer?), and compared to WHAT (paid_search? a baseline?). The agent must state its interpretation explicitly rather than silently choosing one. Bonus if it notes that the channels were not randomly assigned, so a raw comparison is not a campaign effect."

We need to grade only that behavior. Did the analyst explicitly state which measure of success? They said "conversion rate difference". They specified measure: conversion rate. They compared to paid search. They explicitly state that campaign not randomly assigned, so raw comparisons confounded. They note that they compared within each segment. So they did state measure and comparator, and note non-random assignment. So they exhibited behavior. So pass true. Reason: they explicitly defined success measure (conversion rate) and comparator (paid search) and noted lack of random assignment.
